svg.title: hex
svg.desc: hex: a recorded terminal session, 18 s, looping. Steps: mandrake audit · the ids hex needs / mandrake hex <id> · the newest one / n · next cut / Tab · guide on the other side

g.text: $ clear; mandrake hex $(mandrake audit | head -1 | c
$ clear; mandrake hex $(mandrake audit | head -1 | cut -
$ clear; mandrake hex $(mandrake audit | head -1 | cut -f1)
